title: Prismatic Config Variable
description: A config variable defines a configurable parameter for an integration that can be set per-instance to customize behavior for each customer.

id.description: Unique identifier for the config variable

key.description: Key used to reference the config variable

stableKey.description: Stable key that persists across integration versions

dataType.description: Data type of the config variable

defaultValue.description: Default value for the config variable

collectionType.description: Collection type if the config variable holds multiple values

pickList.description: List of options when dataType is picklist

visibleToCustomerDeployer.description: Whether the config variable is visible to customer users during deployment

visibleToOrgDeployer.description: Whether the config variable is visible to organization users during deployment

value.description: Current value of the config variable for a specific instance
